records.title: Assist
excerpts: It lets you control your smart home with natural language, and it can run fully on your own hardware
It can work locally or, if you prefer, use one of the latest large language models to handle more conversational requests.
records.support_scope: 支持已存在本地自然语言智能家居路线；不支持本作品优于它或市场规模的推断。

records.title: Local Assist pipeline
excerpts: Assist can run entirely on your own hardware.
Only supports a subset
quality can change quite a bit.
records.support_scope: 支持本地语音各环节、模型能力和硬件取舍；官方特定设备时延不是本机实测。

records.title: Ollama integration
excerpts: Controlling Home Assistant is an experimental feature
Only models that support [Tools](https://ollama.com/search?c=tools) may control Home Assistant.
Note that smaller models are more likely to make mistakes than larger models.
records.support_scope: 支持本地LLM设备控制已存在且有权限/能力限制；不支持本作品中文准确率。

records.title: Assist with an AI personality
excerpts: if the intent can be answered by Home Assistant it will.
If you deselect the option, all the intents will go through the agent.
records.support_scope: 支持HA已有本地意图优先再用LLM的设置；不能以规则优先或回退宣称独创。

records.title: OpenAI integration
excerpts: You can control what devices and entities it can access from the [exposed entities page](https://my.home-assistant.io/redirect/voice_assistants).
records.support_scope: 支持已有云模型设备控制及实体授权；不能把本作品动作白名单描述成唯一。

records.title: Recommendation ITU-R M.2160-0 (11/2023)
excerpts: This usage scenario would support distributed computing and AI applications.
offloading of heavy computation operations across devices and
computing resource orchestration and chaining.
records.support_scope: §3 Artificial Intelligence and Communication 支持通信与计算协同愿景；不证明本系统接入6G或实现分布式模型切分。

records.title: Multi-access Edge Computing (MEC)
excerpts: Multi-access Edge Computing (MEC) offers application developers and content providers cloud-computing capabilities and an IT service environment at the edge of the network.
MEC is not only focused on mobile networks, but also fixed and WLAN accesses
records.support_scope: 支持边缘应用和网络信息API演进路径；低时延高带宽为官方背景描述，不能当本作品测量。

records.title: RouteLLM README
excerpts: RouteLLM is a framework for serving and evaluating LLM routers.
Each routing request has a _cost threshold_ that controls the tradeoff between cost and quality.
records.support_scope: 支持通用模型路由和成本质量折中已存在；不迁移其benchmark收益数字到本系统。

excerpts: Model prices are listed in units of per 1M tokens.
Product prices may vary and DeepSeek reserves the right to adjust them.
